purpose: Design for ordered backend selection (doc-link or doc-db, configurable preference) across the four document search wrappers, covering doc-db HTTP access, availability checks, index preparation, delegation, errors and tests.
summary: Backend order resolved from .claude/.forge.yaml doc_backend.prefer, defaulting to doc-link first, with strict settings validation
Responsibility split: each backend owns its availability check and operations; only the SKILL selector owns the order
doc-db access through a stdlib Streamable HTTP client with JSON-RPC and SSE parsing, on-demand startup and probe constants
Outcome classification: unavailable falls through to the next backend, operation failure is explicit, missing index triggers approval then sync
doc-db query and update design: project key, branch series, path existence check, desired-state sync with start and status polling
doc-link design: query-docs, freshness checked by doc-link, embed-dlid and index-docs for update, population differences notice
Query-to-update delegation with an explicitly specified backend, plus exit codes 0, 10, 20 and 30
doc-db MCP tool contract snapshot and KEY and series state behavior
Error handling, user notifications, sequence diagrams and unit, wrapper, integration and contract test design
tasks: Implementing or modifying query-db and update-db wrapper SKILLs
Changing backend selection order or doc_backend settings
Modifying doc_backend scripts such as query_docdb, sync_docdb and resolve_backend_order
Designing index preparation approval and delegation flows
Writing tests for backend selection and doc-db client
Reviewing backend selection design consistency with requirements
